items.title: File Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben. Die Frist beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei Versand durch die Post am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post eintritt.
items.computation: Letter dated/posted Thursday 2026-11-19 (no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date stated, so the printed date is used as posting day). Finanzamt → 4-day deemed-delivery rule applies (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO): 19.11.2026 + 4 days = Monday 2026-11-23. That day is a normal working day (not Sat/Sun/holiday in NW), so no shift is needed — delivery = 2026-11-23. One-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO, §§ 187, 188 BGB): day of delivery not counted, period runs one month and ends on the day with the same number one month later: 2026-12-23 (Wednesday). 23 Dec 2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW, so no further shift applies (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

items.title: Receipt of refund interest (Erstattungszinsen)
items.quote: Der Betrag wird mit der Erstattung überwiesen.
items.computation: The letter states the interest amount of 42,00 € will be transferred together with the underlying tax refund, but gives no specific calendar date or deadline for that transfer, and the date of the refund itself is not stated in this letter. Therefore no exact due date can be determined.

warnings: The payout date for the 42,00 € refund interest is not stated in the letter and could not be determined; it will be paid together with the (separately issued) income tax refund for 2023.
